title: Claw Agent Schema
description: Production schema for a Claw cellular agent. Defines state (γ, η, δ), model config, seed, equipment, shell lifecycle, and molt protocol. Enforced by Verification Checklist CONS-1..CONS-3, MOLT-1..MOLT-6, OPT-1.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Claw agent

version.description: Semantic version of this Claw agent definition

model.description: ML model configuration for this agent

temperature.description: Gumbel-Softmax temperature T. Task mode T≈1.0, idle mode T≈2.0

deterministic.description: If true, enforces T=0, fixed seed for deterministic Ghost Tile semantics

state.description: Thermodynamic state variables per P56-60. Conservation law: γ + η + δ = 1, δ ∈ [0, 0.25]

gamma.description: γ — Crystallized intelligence (c̄). Increases when semantic distance Δ ∈ [0.4, 0.6]

eta.description: η — Liquid intelligence. η = (1−γ)² in one-phase model (P56 Eq 3)

delta.description: δ — Conservation deviation from ideal conservation. δ = 1−(γ+η). Must be in [0, 0.25]

mode.description: Operational mode: ONE_PHASE uses η = (1−γ)²; TWO_PHASE tracks η explicitly

crystallizationRate.description: dγ/dt — current crystallization rate. Positive when in creative zone (Δ∈[0.4,0.6])

temperature.description: Current Gumbel-Softmax temperature T. DRM-1: T_idle rises monotonically. Clamping: [0.1, ∞)

semanticDistance.description: Δ(t) — current semantic distance from knowledge base. Creative zone: Δ∈[0.4, 0.6]. P02/P56

lastValidation.description: t_v — timestamp when γ was last validated against current data. Staleness drives melt pressure.

moltCount.description: Number of completed molt transitions. MOLT-6: molt chain < 5. P59

capability.description: m(t) — current capability after molt transition. MOLT-4: m(t) = m(0)·min(1, γ(t))

equipment.description: Active equipment modules. Equipment are dynamically equipped/unequipped per P59.

seed.description: Seed definition: purpose, trigger, learning strategy, default equipment

moltCount.description: Count of molt transitions this shell has undergone

identityHash.description: SHA-256 hash of (model.weights || seed || hash). P03 Kan extension invariant: π₁ ∘ μ = id_S. Used for MOLT-5 identity preservation check.

executionContext.description: P01/P56: Ghost Tile execution context C for deterministic semantics

kvCacheFingerprint.description: Hash of KV-cache state at last inference

attentionPatternHash.description: Hash of attention pattern at last inference

lastInputHash.description: SHA-256 of last input (s ⊕ x) for determinism verification

lastOutputHash.description: SHA-256 of last output for determinism verification

capability.description: m(t) — current capability after molt transition. P59 MOLT-4

origin.description: P03: Origin tracking — where this agent was spawned from

equipmentSlot.description: An equipment slot on a Claw agent

active.description: Whether this equipment is currently equipped

activationCondition.description: P59: Condition for auto-equip. Used for muscle memory extraction.

seed.description: Seed definition: machine-learnable behavior definition. P01

purpose.description: Natural language description of the agent's purpose

constraints.description: P03: CSPersist constraints defining valid operation space

trigger.description: Event or schedule that activates this agent

event.description: CNS event name to listen for

learningStrategy.description: How this agent's behavior is learned/optimized

constraint.description: P03 CSPersist constraint: guarantees invariant preservation across phases

field.description: JSON pointer to the field this constraint applies to
